principle: A filename search (discovery) does NOT establish that the discovered material is the corpus you intend to measure. The corpus must be an OPERATOR-AUTHORIZED, fingerprinted, in-scope manifest — frozen BEFORE any swarm runs. No manifest => no run (NO CORPUS = NO CLAIM).

MANIFEST.CORPUS_ID: stable id for this frozen corpus
MANIFEST.AUTHORIZED_BY: operator (required; discovery alone is not authorization)
MANIFEST.FROZEN_AT_PATH: LOCAL NON-GIT path (e.g. ~/helen_kernel/...). For client/entity corpora this MUST be outside the git-tracked SOT and never pushed.

FILES.in_scope: true|false — operator-declared; only in_scope=true files are read by the swarm
derived_from: path/source_id ... KNOWN ancestry (feeds PROVENANCE_SCHEMA ancestry graph)

MANIFEST.MANIFEST_HASH: sha256 over the sorted in_scope file hashes + CORPUS_ID (the freeze seal)

gates_before_swarm: every FILES[] entry has a sha256 and an explicit in_scope flag (operator-set)
FROZEN_AT_PATH is non-git for any client/entity corpus (firewall)
MANIFEST_HASH computed and frozen; the swarm binds to this hash
self_authored ratio reported: if most in_scope files are SELF_AUTHORED, warn that independent-root headroom is low BY CONSTRUCTION (N_E likely ~1)
run_binding: The swarm records MANIFEST_HASH in its receipts; a run whose corpus hash != frozen MANIFEST_HASH is CONTAMINATED and void.

downstream_membrane.note: SCALE_V2 evidence != website mutation. Surviving claims may later feed a SEPARATE website-claim lane, which is itself BLOCKED here.
downstream_membrane.CONCEPT_RENDER_rule: Any generated (e.g. Higgsfield) maritime/data-center imagery is tagged CONCEPT_RENDER — 'makes the future visible, not true' — and is NEVER evidence of an existing installation.
